LifeSafer Intelligent Speed Assistance (ISA) helps fleet operators improve driver safety, reduce operating costs, and extend vehicle life by automatically keeping vehicles within posted speed limits. By reducing excessive speeding, harsh acceleration, and aggressive driving behaviors, fleets can lower fuel consumption, minimize wear and tear, and create a safer driving culture across their organization.

For fleet managers, LifeSafer ISA provides powerful telematics and GPS-based insights that support smarter fleet operations. Real-time data on speed, idle time, harsh braking, and driver behavior allows companies to identify inefficiencies, improve accountability, and make data-driven decisions that reduce overall fleet expenses while increasing operational visibility.

By encouraging smoother driving habits, ISA can significantly reduce maintenance costs tied to brakes, tires, transmissions, and engine strain — helping maximize vehicle lifecycle performance and improve long-term asset utilization. Fleets often see measurable savings in fuel spend, accident-related expenses, and unplanned downtime while improving driver retention and public safety.

LifeSafer ISA also helps organizations strengthen compliance and risk management efforts through features like tamper detection, speed event monitoring, and automated speed control. Whether managing a service fleet, delivery operation, utility vehicles, or company trucks, ISA creates a safer and more efficient fleet environment designed to protect drivers, vehicles, and the bottom line.
